plan: reports/plans/2026-10-22_plan_small-update-reruns.md -> E24 and its Agent notes; definitions as E18 (reports/plans/2026-10-21_plan_regating-leak.md). Filed before any run; never edited after.
states: do-nothing states (target W0 + dW, released subcomponents C0, Gamma frozen, Delta out of the masked model) of 10-step arm-A fine-tunes of all 24 matrices, seed 0, batch 32: emoticon with Adam 3e-5 (large, E18's state), SGD 0.01 and Adam 3e-6 (small, E21's matched pair, size 0.0024 and 0.0022). Extra: r1_t534_v369 with the SGD rate E4's rule picks from (0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1) (P >= 0.9, KL elsewhere <= 0.24302), beside its Adam 3e-5 state; skipped, with the grid recorded, if no rate passes

measurements.r: (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0), held-out windows' trigger log-odds of the target; L = CI-masked model with C0
measurements.recovery rho_x: (lo_x - L00) / (L01 - L00) with pattern x at the trigger and W0's gates elsewhere (commute.regating)
measurements.shared: clip(g0(x) + s), s = mean over the TRAINING windows of state minus W0 trigger gates, alive only
measurements.mean: m1 for every window (mean_W0: m0, reported)
measurements.cross: clip(g0(x) + s_null), s_null from a ' http' (3944) fine-tune by the SAME optimiser and rate
measurements.random: s's values on S_on (s > 0.3) moved onto a random same-size-per-matrix set outside S_on, 20 draws

gates.G1_large_reproduces: emoticon Adam 3e-5: |r - E18 seed 0 (0.5972)| <= 0.05; rho trig, shared, mean within 0.02 of E18 seed 0 (0.973, 0.715, 0.896); gain >= 1.0; W0's gates through trig and shared recover <= 1e-06. Runs first, alone; fail: stop, nothing else run
